title: Madecassoside Induces Apoptosis and Inhibits Migration by Regulating ROS-Mediated Signaling Pathways in MDA-MB-231 Breast Cancer Cells.
authors: Hou, Wen-Shuang; Luo, Ying-Hua; Wu, Nan; Tang, Yan-Jun; Liu, Yan-Zhi; Zhang, Yan-Liang; Jin, Cheng-Hao
one_liner_zh: 研究天然化合物Madecassoside对乳腺癌细胞的凋亡与迁移抑制作用，涉及ROS信号通路和分子对接，但核心是细胞实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Madecassoside (MC) is an anti-inflammatory and antibacterial active substance extracted from the traditional Chinese medicine Centella asiatica. Based on network pharmacology and experimental validation, this study assessed MC's anti-breast cancer (BC) actions and related molecular pathways. CCK-8, Trypan Blue, and Hoechst33342/PI assays showed that MC significantly reduced BC cell activity, but it had little inhibitory effects on normal cells. Network pharmacology analysis predicted 40 intersection targets between MC and BC, 291 GO-related biological processes, and 105 KEGG signaling pathways. The anti-breast cancer activity of MC is closely related to reactive oxygen species (ROS), AKT and MAPK signaling pathways. Through Annexin V-FITC/PI, flow cytometry, transwell, wound healing and western blotting experiments, it was found that MC induced mitochondria-dependent apoptosis, G2/M phase arrest and inhibited cell migration of MDA-MB-231 cells through MAPK/STAT3/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, PI3K/AKT signaling pathway and AKT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway, respectively. The induction and blocking effects were inhibited by the addition of ROS scavenger N-acetyl cysteine (NAC). Molecular docking showed that MC had significant binding ability with STAT3, CASP3, BCL2 and JUN targets in BC. In summary, MC induced apoptosis, cell cycle arrest, and migration inhibition via ROS-mediated MAPK/STAT3/NF-kappaB, PI3K/AKT, and AKT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathways in MDA-MB-231 cells.
abstract_zh: 羟基积雪草苷（Madecassoside, MC）是从中药积雪草中提取的一种具有抗炎和抗菌活性的活性物质。本研究基于网络药理学和实验验证，评估了MC的抗乳腺癌（BC）作用及其相关分子通路。CCK-8、台盼蓝和Hoechst33342/PI实验表明，MC显著降低BC细胞活性，但对正常细胞抑制作用较小。网络药理学分析预测了MC与BC之间的40个交集靶点、291个GO相关生物过程及105条KEGG信号通路。MC的抗乳腺癌活性与活性氧（ROS）、AKT和MAPK信号通路密切相关。通过Annexin V-FITC/PI、流式细胞术、transwell、伤口愈合和western blotting实验发现，MC通过MAPK/STAT3/NF-kappaB信号通路、PI3K/AKT信号通路和AKT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin信号通路分别诱导MDA-MB-231细胞线粒体依赖性凋亡、G2/M期阻滞并抑制细胞迁移。添加ROS清除剂N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）可抑制这些诱导和阻断效应。分子对接显示，MC与BC中的STAT3、CASP3、BCL2和JUN靶点具有显著结合能力。总之，MC通过ROS介导的MAPK/STAT3/NF-kappaB、PI3K/AKT和AKT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin信号通路在MDA-MB-231细胞中诱导凋亡、细胞周期阻滞和迁移抑制。
